marta: Morning y'all — quick release-train check. Current plan: canary at 09:30 PT for release-2.0.1. Drop your 3-lines (what I did / blockers / today) and note any cherry-picks you need.

deploy-bot: infra-status OK, CI queue length 3 :white_check_mark:

josh: what I did: merged #4124 (optimize batching). blockers: cherry-pick to release branch caused a failing unit test (redis race). today: try backport & ping infra. tagging @evan

josh: ```
$ git checkout release-2.0.1
$ git cherry-pick -x abcdef123456
error: could not apply abcdef123456... fix: redis conn nil pointer in session.go
CI: test_utils/redis_test.go:87: assertion failed
```

evan: I'll take the cherry-pick — looks like a flake from connection pooling. I'll rebase, drop the unrelated change, and force-push to release-2.0.1-cherries. ETA ~30m.

priya: what I did: prepared canary config and traffic split. blockers: staging perf regression on p99 in kv-cache path (+12%). Investigating with @ben. today: either mitigate (reduce batch size) or hold canary.

ben: note: if we hold the canary, still push non-customer-facing fixes. prepping rollback PR #4128 as a safety net. auto-rollback policy set to trigger if p99 > 180ms :warning:

josh: update: infra suggested setting ulimit -n 65536 on the runner, re-running tests. CI passed locally after that. re-pushing cherry-pick.

josh: ```
$ git checkout -b backport/4124-to-2.0.1
$ git cherry-pick -x abcdef123456
$ git push origin backport/4124-to-2.0.1:release-2.0.1-cherries --force
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4132
```

marta: Plan: evan lands the cherry and runs CI. If staging p99 < 150ms by 09:15 PT, proceed with 30m canary at 09:30 PT; else hold and schedule hotfix window. I'll notify product & support. @deploy-bot please schedule canary 09:30 PT for 30m.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary 2026-03-17T09:30:00PT (30m)

priya: perf comparison: https://perf.redwood/compare/abcd — staging shows +12% p99 on kv-cache. I'll post flame traces to eng-releases.

evan: landed backport PR #4132 to release-2.0.1-cherries, CI green. kicking staging deploy now.

marta: Great — monitoring now. Ping here immediately if anything looks off. :eyes:
